India to Host 'Tarang Shakti 2026' Air Exercise with Global Jets

India is set to host the 'Tarang Shakti 2026' air exercise, which will feature fighter jets from multiple countries. The United States is expected to participate with its F-35 fighter jets. Bangladesh is also reportedly sending a fighter jet to the exercise. The event is anticipated to cause concern in China and Pakistan.
